The architecture diagrams in this thesis are the author\textquotesingle s own draw.io drawings of the cited methods and their local integration. Embedded ROAD-Waymo imagery retains the dataset attribution in the relevant captions.

anchor: The reported comparison uses the selected epoch-1 checkpoint from the configured 50-epoch training recipe.
new: The recorded local configuration uses SGD, batch size 32, and learning-rate endpoints 0.005 and 0.0005, informed by the challenge report \cite{road-challenge-2024}. It uses a single 50-epoch decay schedule and \texttt{close\_mosaic=5}, rather than the report\textquotesingle s separate 30-epoch pretraining and 20-epoch fine-tuning stages. The 1280-pixel input and standard single YOLOv8x detector are local choices; the challenge\textquotesingle s multi-branch detector and low-light enhancement system are not reproduced.

anchor: The corrected contrastive objective aligns the pre-language visual representation with adapted phrases across all 184 labels.
new: Supervised contrastive learning provides the multiple-positive averaging precedent \cite{supcon}; here, the local objective compares each visual representation with class phrases rather than other visual samples in a batch. It is also one-directional, unlike CLIP\textquotesingle s symmetric image--text pretraining loss \cite{clip}.
